tldr: Sun in the 11th house: identity becomes personal through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
body:
With the Sun in the 11th house, this part of you develops through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans. The Sun describes identity, vitality, confidence, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center. In practice, this brings attention to the people, audiences, collaborations, and shared futures you choose to belong to.

When this placement is supported, your place in a wider network can feel more meaningful and alive. The Sun can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose.

When it is strained, belonging can become performative, or a future plan can outgrow the people attached to it. The harder pattern can show up as over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
challenge: over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth around friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
